# discord_sku (Data Source)

Lists the SKUs (premium offerings) for a Discord application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_sku" "all" {
  application_id = "123456789012345678"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the application.

### Read-Only

- `skus` (Attributes List) The application's SKUs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--skus))

<a id="nestedatt--skus"></a>
### Nested Schema for `skus`

Read-Only:

- `flags` (Number) SKU flags bitfield.
- `id` (String) SKU snowflake ID.
- `name` (String) Customer-facing SKU name.
- `slug` (String) URL slug for the SKU.
- `type` (Number) SKU type.
